name: Stonewrought Pass
summary: Iron gates bar Stonewrought Pass between Loch Modan and Searing Gorge. Franclorn Forgewright cut the tunnel through the southern mountains, joining the Valley of Kings to Dustfire Valley and shielding dwarven lands from the volcanic dangers beyond.

sections.title: A Gateway Carved in Stone
sections.body: Franclorn Forgewright carved Stonewrought Pass through the bedrock. The master architect also built the massive Stonewrought Dam. The tunnel runs from Loch Modan near the Valley of Kings, through the mountain ridge, and down into Dustfire Valley. Dark Iron dwarves and fiery beasts threaten travelers in Searing Gorge. So the Ironforge mountaineers keep heavy gates locked at both ends, guarding the way north into Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where does the Stonewrought Pass lead?
faq.answer: Stonewrought Pass runs through the mountains from the Valley of Kings on Loch Modan’s southern edge to Dustfire Valley in northern Searing Gorge.
Franclorn Forgewright, the master dwarven architect, designed the tunnel. Across Khaz Modan, he is famed for the Stonewrought Dam and other monumental stone works.

Heavy gates bar the pass against Searing Gorge’s fiery monsters and hostile Dark Iron dwarves. Mountaineer Pebblebitty guards the Loch Modan entrance and requires authorization before allowing passage.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Franclorn Forgewright’s skill in the tunnel’s stonework. The pass now borders territory conquered by your wayward Dark Iron kin.
Dwarven Mountaineers guard this locked passage, shielding Loch Modan’s vulnerable settlements from the volcanic threats in Searing Gorge.
